name: Codex Lens
tagline: Your Codex chats on Even G2
description: Use your own Codex account from Even G2 and R1. Setup: 1) install Codex Lens Companion on your Windows PC, 2) sign into your own Codex account in the companion, 3) open Codex Lens in Even Hub and tap Scan companion QR, 4) photograph the QR shown on your PC. Then browse your chats, hold the ring or temple to speak, or tap and scroll to type entirely on the glasses. Your OpenAI login stays on your PC; prompts and replies are end-to-end encrypted.
author: Sam Wolfsdell

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connect through the encrypted Codex Lens relay to the user's own desktop companion.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Capture a held-to-talk voice prompt and send it to the user's paired Codex session.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Photograph the one-time QR code shown by Codex Lens Companion to pair this phone securely.
